behaviorProven: Class A/B routes now require governance evidence in addition to Dojo proof before a MutationLease activates.
Verified Dojo proof without approved permit/change-order/route revision produces holding status.
Verified Dojo proof with an issued permit linked to the execution plan route produces active status.
Governance evidence is stored in lease JSON, policy decision input, policy decision output, and tower event details.
